body:
Adds `research/escalation-bonds`: exact backward-induction solution of escalating-bond disputes with a fallible oracle.

- Deterrence opening bond `εV/((1−ε)C−εD)` (matches exact game on 400 random instances); falls geometrically in rounds while attacker's total outlay barely moves.
- Sharp budget race: defender needs `γ·max{C(r) ≤ B_C}` ≤ `γ·B_C` (500/500 matches).
- γ vs latency trade-off, lock-up griefing ratio.
- 9 tests, experiments, white paper; portfolio page and root README updated.
